backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles with access control and full CRUD product management with admin restrictions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related frontend files, components, and test identifiers.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file for documentation or planning.
frontend/index.css: Empty stylesheet file reserved for global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point defining metadata, fonts, icons, and mounting the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes for all pages and wraps the app with theming and notifications.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI screen shown when a user lacks permissions, offering login or navigation home.
Route guard that checks authentication and admin role before rendering protected content.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Page layout wrapper providing header, footer, main content outlet, and profile setup modal.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Handles Internet Identity login/logout behavior and clears cached data on logout.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Reusable product card linking to product details and showing image, brand, description, and price.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal prompting new authenticated users to enter and save their profile name.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Renders the site footer with branding, navigation links, legal info, and an affiliate disclosure.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Provides the main site header with logo, navigation, admin link detection, login button, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminProducts.ts: Wraps product create, update, and delete operations with React Query mutations and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication, exposing identity, login, logout, and status via context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines user and product data queries using the actor, including profiles, roles, and product retrieval.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets global Tailwind styles and theme variables for light and dark modes using a luxury‑styled palette.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminProductsPage.tsx: Implements the admin product management UI with listing, creation, editing, and deletion dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/AffiliateDisclosurePa: Static page explaining affiliate link usage, earnings, privacy, and FTC compliance.
frontend/src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx: Displays products filtered by category with loading states and empty-category messaging.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page with hero section and featured product previews for fashion, jewelry, and luxury.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailsPage.ts: Shows detailed product info with image, description, price, and affiliate link plus loading and error states.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, typography, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, completed features, and pending feature requests for the aura&adorn affiliate marketing site.
